title: Time Out Fishing Charters
specs: Fishing for striped bass, fluke, mahi mahi, king & Spanish mackerel, bonito, false albacore
Boat is a 21 foot center console Contender with Yamaha 200 HPDI engine
Fishing in calm back bay waters and ocean near Atlantic City and Brigantine
No illegal drugs allowed; marijuana not allowed
Beer and wine permitted in moderation; no hard liquor
Any inappropriate conduct may result in trip termination without refund
Persons damaging vessel or equipment responsible for repair or replacement
Please inform captain of important health concerns before departure
Rates based on 1-4 anglers; cost divided among group
includes: Rods, reels, tackle and bait included
Fish cleaning back at the dock included
blurb: Guests fish for striped bass, fluke, and other species in back bay and ocean waters near Atlantic City and Brigantine. Trips include all fishing gear and bait, and fish cleaning is done back at the dock. Custom charters, sunset and nature cruises, and dining trips by boat are also available.
extraNote: $150 deposit due upon booking for 4 hour trips; $200 for longer trips · Deposit is nonrefundable if cancelled less than 12 days before scheduled date · If weather does not allow sailing, deposit applies to reschedule or refund · Balance due at dock before departure in cash; 3% surcharge for credit card · Pick-up locations in Absecon, Atlantic City (dock near AC Aquarium), and Brigantine Public Boat Ramp/Dock.
